responsibility: This file translates non-I/O executable Fortran statements from gfc_code into GCC statement trees. It covers control flow and label machinery, ENTRY/CALL/RETURN/IF/DO/FORALL/WHERE constructs, SELECT TYPE/RANK, synchronization and coarray statements, allocation and deallocation, and related runtime checks and cleanups; in doing so it coordinates scalarization, dependency-sensitive evaluation, finalization, coarray deregistration, and STAT/ERRMSG paths so statement-level Fortran semantics are preserved in the generated GENERIC.
same_name_distinction: Implements translation of executable statements into GCC trees, including control flow, allocation/deallocation, coarray synchronization, WHERE/FORALL/DO handling, and related runtime checks. Unlike gcc/fortran/trans-stmt.h, it contains the actual statement-lowering code rather than the dispatcher and translator prototypes.
